entities.name: Iquatana
entities.description: A plane whose atmosphere is almost pure aether, where creatures warp and turn into other organisms; featured on the card The Aether Flues.

entities.name: Iquati
entities.description: The intelligent inhabitants of Iquatana who created the Narcomoeba.

entities.name: Narcomoeba
entities.description: Beings of pure memory created by the Iquati as vessels for storing future memories.

entities.name: Aether
entities.description: The plasma-like substance that makes up Iquatana's atmosphere and vents from its flues.

events.summary: The Iquati create the Narcomoebas to store future memories, replacing genealogical memory lost in some unknown past event.
events.quote: created Narcomoebas, beings of pure memory

relations.note: Created as vessels for storing future memories.
relations.quote: created Narcomoebas, beings of pure memory
